def.en: An infection passed mainly through sexual contact, caused by bacteria, viruses or parasites. The older term is STD.
def.hg: Aisa infection jo mainly sexual contact se failta hai aur bacteria, virus ya parasite se hota hai. Iska purana naam STD hai.

def.en: Having an infection without any signs or symptoms. An asymptomatic person can still pass the infection to others.
def.hg: Infection hona, par uska koi sign ya symptom na hona. Asymptomatic insaan bhi infection doosron tak pass kar sakta hai.

def.en: Human immunodeficiency virus, which weakens the immune system. It can be controlled with daily medicines but cannot yet be cured.
def.hg: Human immunodeficiency virus, jo immune system ko weak karta hai. Daily medicines se ise control kiya ja sakta hai, par abhi iska cure nahi hai.

def.en: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome: the advanced stage of untreated HIV, when the body can no longer fight off serious infections.
def.hg: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome: untreated HIV ka advanced stage, jab body serious infections se lad nahi paati.

def.en: Human papillomavirus, a very common virus spread by skin-to-skin sexual contact. Some types cause genital warts or cancers, and a vaccine prevents the main types.
def.hg: Human papillomavirus, ek bahut common virus jo sexual contact mein skin-to-skin se failta hai. Iske kuch types genital warts ya cancers karte hain, aur vaccine main types se bachati hai.

def.en: A virus that infects the liver and spreads through blood, sexual fluids and from mother to baby. A vaccine prevents it.
def.hg: Ek virus jo liver ko infect karta hai aur blood, sexual fluids aur maa se baby mein failta hai. Vaccine isse bachati hai.

def.en: A 28-day course of HIV medicines, started within 72 hours of a possible exposure, to prevent infection.
def.hg: HIV medicines ka 28 din ka course, jo possible exposure ke 72 ghante ke andar start kiya jaata hai taaki infection na ho.

def.en: Medicine taken by HIV-negative people before a possible exposure to prevent HIV, prescribed and monitored by a clinician.
def.hg: Woh medicine jo HIV-negative log possible exposure se pehle HIV se bachne ke liye lete hain; ise clinician prescribe aur monitor karte hain.

def.en: Daily medicines that keep HIV suppressed, protect the immune system and allow a long, healthy life.
def.hg: Roz li jaane wali medicines jo HIV ko suppressed rakhti hain, immune system ko protect karti hain aur lambi, healthy life possible banati hain.

def.en: So little HIV in the blood that tests cannot measure it. A person who stays undetectable does not transmit HIV sexually.
def.hg: Blood mein HIV ki itni kam amount ki test use measure na kar sake. Jo insaan undetectable bana rehta hai, woh sexually HIV transmit nahi karta.

def.en: The time between exposure to an infection and the point when a test can reliably detect it. Testing earlier can give a false negative.
def.hg: Infection ke exposure aur us point ke beech ka time jab test use reliably detect kar sake. Isse pehle test karane par false negative aa sakta hai.

def.en: Letting sexual partners know about a diagnosis so that they can be tested and treated, done directly or with help from a clinic.
def.hg: Sexual partners ko diagnosis ke baare mein batana taaki woh bhi test aur treatment kara sakein; yeh directly ya clinic ki help se kiya jaata hai.
